findings.title: The current handoff still contradicts the implementation diff
findings.evidence: The summary still states that the backend adds “three migrations” even though the current diff contains 172256, 172257, 172258, and 172259. Its backend changed-file inventory also omits current tracked changes such as .github/workflows/ci.yml, apps/api/src/configure-app.ts, and package.json. This regresses the handoff defect from reviews 006 and 007 and makes the claimed complete current-cycle inventory unreliable.
findings.expected_fix: Regenerate implementation.json from the current worktrees: state four migrations, inventory every tracked and untracked implementation file, reconcile the 3000/3010 runtime evidence, and ensure all validation claims refer only to the current cycle.

findings.title: Catalog seeding does not converge existing taxonomy rows
findings.evidence: seedTerm returns an existing term immediately instead of reconciling displayName, status, sortOrder, parentId, or swatchHex with the canonical seed definition. A rerun therefore preserves stale or manually altered taxonomy content while row-count-only evidence still reports idempotency, violating AC6’s correct, repeatable classification requirement.
findings.expected_fix: Update or upsert existing terms to the canonical seed fields while retaining stable identity, and add an integration test that mutates each relevant field, reruns the seed, and verifies full content convergence without duplicates.

findings.title: Blank and empty filter values bypass malformed-query validation
findings.evidence: transformCsv trims and filters empty tokens, so inputs such as categoryIds=, become an empty array and pass each:true UUID validation as an unfiltered request. The same permissive helper exists in list-card-templates.dto.ts and list-catalog-terms.dto.ts; blank numeric product filters are also coerced by Number. AC12 requires invalid filter formats to return the standard validation error.
findings.expected_fix: Reject blank CSV values and empty segments before element validation, reject blank numeric values, apply the rule consistently to all catalog DTOs, and add E2E cases for empty, comma-only, leading/trailing-empty, and blank numeric parameters.

findings.title: Aggregate replacement writes are not atomic
findings.evidence: saveWithVariantsAndCatalogLinks saves the product, deletes variants and catalog links, then reinserts them using independent repository calls without a transaction. A collision or database failure after either delete leaves a partially persisted product with missing offers or classifications. The card-template repository uses the same non-atomic delete/reinsert pattern, so a failed development seed can corrupt previously valid catalog data.
findings.expected_fix: Execute the aggregate save and child/link replacement in one TypeORM transaction or project UnitOfWork for both products and card templates, and add an integration test proving rollback when a child insert fails.

findings.title: The fidelity capture script retains the stale API default
findings.evidence: The script defaults API_URL to http://localhost:3000 even though the current implementation record says the backend had to run on 3010 and captures required an explicit override. The current evidence is valid because the override was supplied, but a documented no-argument rerun is not reproducible in the recorded environment.
findings.expected_fix: Derive the API origin from the same validated environment/config used by public-web or update the checked-in default and run instructions so the capture precondition succeeds without hidden runtime knowledge.

findings.title: The card search action is visually interactive but has no behavior
findings.evidence: The “Tìm mẫu” button is type=button with no click handler, and the adjacent input is not submitted by a form. Search eventually occurs only through the 400 ms debounce, so clicking the explicit action or pressing Enter does not commit the search immediately as the control implies.
findings.expected_fix: Use an accessible search form or wire click and Enter submission to commit the trimmed query and URL state immediately, retaining debounce only if desired; add keyboard and click tests.

summary: Coverage is complete across both worktrees and all seven review passes. Current automated validation and fidelity artifacts pass, and most prior defects are resolved. The implementation is not ready for acceptance because taxonomy seeding does not converge existing data, malformed empty filters bypass validation, aggregate replacement writes can partially corrupt seeded data, and the required handoff remains stale and incomplete.
